name: worktree_link
title: Update worktree symlinks
description: Apply or update symlinks in existing worktrees

directory.description: Target Git repository (absolute or relative path)

force.description: Overwrite real files and directories without asking

destination.description: Absolute path the symlink points to

change.description: create: a new symlink; update: an existing one was replaced; skip: left as it was; error: could not be made

reason.description: Why the link was skipped or failed (omitted for create and update)

links.description: One entry per link of the config in each target worktree (an empty array when there is no sub-worktree)

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
